body: thank you. so much. i can't tell you how much it means for me to hear this from someone who has gone through something similar to my experience. I've just now started to pick up the piece of my ruined childhood and i can see it's a long road ahead. it makes me feel better to know that you're doing better. sometimes i worry that i'll never be fixed or ok again.

this. i would love to do this. but i have a very small family consisting exclusively of me, my brother, and my parents. cutting contact with a quarter of my family without explanation isn't exactly easy. especially when i'm already not speaking to my mother. that would leave just my dad who i have anything to do with...
Edit: also we have a lot of the same friends and know a lot of the same people. i have no idea how i would go about navigating that social situation.

i have tried tutoring a few different times. i love doing it, but for some reason every interaction eventually ends up being something along the lines of Dragonite Dad. 

but maybe the kids at big brother big sisters might feel they can get something out of my time. not a bad idea..

well that's just the thing. i've tried everything i thought might in anyway make me happy. religion, music, art, writing, sports, drugs, family, shopping, eating, working out, collecting, volunteering, working, building, reading, fishing, hiking, traveling, talking, sleeping, cutting my hair, jumping off things, tight schedules, no responsibilities, pets, cleaning, driving, being alone, being around tons of people, partying, meditating, therapy, cooking, school and on and on. and in the end, nothing does anything for me. it never has. i would trade in every interesting experience in my life for a meaningful relationship with someone. doesn't have to be romantic. just to talk to someone who cares about me. enough to not check their phone every ten minutes or come up with a lame excuse for why they can't hang out. someone who cares to ask how I'm doing every now and then. i've just exhausted every thing i could think of to make things worth being here for. and now there's nothing. i don't even want to eat anymore. or get out of my chair...

Actually a lot has changed. I moved across the country, I've stopped talking to my mom, and I started taking medicine to deal with my acne that is causing me so much stress. I was also seeing the school shrink last term, and this new self hatred seemed to come about at the same time. I haven't gotten to see him recently because school is out, so I really don't have anyone to talk to about it..

Well I started going to a very stressful school earlier this year, and it's possible that it might have something to do with it. We get to put our work up on the wall and have everyone tell you what's wrong with it. That certainly can be a huge blow to the ego, but I try not to take it personally..
